title: ASTROSSC-289 cross-vault replay
summary: Same signed message replays across multiple ActiveVault<T>. Triager confirmed technically valid; closed Informative citing 'single vault per coin type, maintained operationally — precondition does not exist under current deployment model'. Pre-staged upgrade-overlap rebuttal not engaged with.
key_lesson: HackenProof + threat-model-deferential program + operationally-maintained precondition = Informative closure regardless of severity. Pre-staged rebuttals do not engage triager. Skip platform OR reframe to fire under default deployment.
